# Skills from content packs that this installation must not load.
# One skill directory name per line; # comments allowed.
# Missing file = nothing excluded. The installer reads this from the base
# branch, before any PR-head checkout, so a pull request cannot change it.
#
# The exclusions are the skills that cannot work as an asynchronous GitHub
# agent: browse needs the operator's own logged-in browser, grilling,
# grill-with-docs and improve-codebase-architecture interview a human, and
# domain-modeling and security-audit belong to their own workflows. Everything
# else ships as-is.
browse
grilling
grill-with-docs
improve-codebase-architecture
domain-modeling
security-audit
